d:
An FIR has been registered against senior Supreme Court advocate Prashant Bhushan for sharing an allegedly fake video of Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov. The video appeared to show Lavrov criticising India's foreign policy and its purchase of Russian oil. However, both the Russian Embassy and India's Ministry of External Affairs declared it digitally altered and fake. Delhi Police's Special Cell has registered a case under four sections of the BNS and Section 66C of the IT Act. What exactly is the case against Bhushan? And what do the charges mean?
Production: Akash Singh
